help.body:
📖 *Freedom Bot Help*

① `/start` — Dashboard
② `/users` — Manage users, UUIDs and inbound assignments
③ `/nodes` — Manage REALITY and XHTTP inbounds
④ `/traffic` — User traffic; `/inboundtraffic` — Inbound traffic
⑤ `/online` — Online clients and observed source IPs
⑥ `/version` — Local and upstream versions
⑦ `/update` — Update manager and Bot; core updates require confirmation
⑧ `/restart` — Restart Xray after confirmation
⑨ `/language en|zh-CN` — Select interface language

Commands: `/adduser phone`, `/disableuser phone`, `/enableuser phone`.

🔒 Management is limited to authorized private chats. Changes and core updates require explicit permissions.
